'CSKA Sofia interested in Rangers' Cortes' - gossip
- Published
Bulgarian club CSKA Sofia are reportedly interested in Rangers' Oscar Cortes, while Celtic goalkeeper Sam Johnstone says he's keen to stay beyond his loan deal.
Rangers winger Oscar Cortes, who has earned an international recall with Colombia, is a target for Bulgarian club CSKA Sofia when the 22-year-old's loan ends with Argentine side Huracan at the end of December. (Scottish Sun, external)
Mikey Moore insists he is happy with his decision to move to Cologne this summer, despite murmurs over a January return to Rangers, where the 19-year-old Tottenham Hotspur winger was on loan last season. (Daily Record, external)
Real Madrid, AC Milan and Manchester United have been alerted to Scott McTominay's possible availability after talks over a new contract with Napoli stalled because the Scotland midfielder demanded £5.85m - around £113,000-a-week - with his current deal ending in 18 months. (Daily Record, external)
Scott McTominay is heading into 2027 with one eye on a possible return to the Premier League, with former club Manchester United being made aware of an opportunity to bring the 29-year-old Napoli and Scotland midfielder back to Old Trafford. (TeamTalk, external)
- Friday's Scottish Gossip 
  - Published1 day ago
Celtic are unlikely to be able to afford to take up former midfielder Paul Lambert's suggestion of signing Jadon Sancho, who was released by Manchester United, as the 26-year-old England winger reportedly wanted £2.5m until the end of the season when approached by Getafe. (The Herald, external)
On-loan Wolves goalkeeper Sam Johnstone says he's open to the possibility of staying at Celtic beyond this season and wants to win the title at Parkhead. (Daily Record, external)
Hearts winger Sabah Kerjota hopes the players' recent clear-the-air talks with the management team can help revive their form. (Daily Record, external)
Aberdeen chief executive Adrian Bevington has confirmed the Pittodrie hierarchy have not yet discussed the upcoming January transfer window with new head coach Mario Frick. (Press & Journal, external)
Glentoran manager Duncan Ferguson says he once asked his wife to take him to hospital because he thought he was having a heart attack only to be diagnosed with an anxiety attack. (The Overlap Daily, external)

הקשר בין קבוצת צסקא סופיה הבולגרית לקיצוני ריינג'רס, אוסקר קורטס, נמצא על הפרק לקראת סיום תקופת ההשאלה של השחקן בארגנטינה בחודש דצמבר. במקביל, שוער וולבס המושאל לסלטיק, סאם ג'ונסטון, הביע את רצונו להמשיך במועדון מעבר לתקופת ההשאלה הנוכחית ולזכות באליפות.

בגזרת ההעברות הבולטות, ריאל מדריד, מילאן ומנצ'סטר יונייטד גילו עניין באפשרות לצרף את סקוט מקטומינאי מנאפולי, לאחר ששיחות הארכת החוזה שלו נעצרו בעקבות דרישות שכר גבוהות. מנצ'סטר יונייטד אף עשויה לבחון אפשרות להשיב את הקשר הוותיק לאולד טראפורד לקראת שנת 2027.
